segments.title: How OLD is the sunlight on your face?
segments.say: Part two. How old is the sunlight on your face right now? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Thousands of years!
segments.sub: Its energy spent about **40,000 years** inside the Sun
segments.say: Thousands of years! NASA says its energy spent about forty thousand years inside the Sun.

segments.title: Trapped inside the SUN
segments.sub: Absorbed and sent out **again and again**
segments.say: It gets absorbed and sent out again and again before it reaches the surface.

segments.title: 8 minutes is the LAST leg
segments.say: The trip from the Sun to your face? Only the last eight minutes.
